description: Emergency on-site troubleshooting and repair of stopped production machinery (winding machines, drying ovens, cutting lines, drives); connecting the laptop to machine controllers; reloading programs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A stopped coil winding line or drying oven at Customer A or B delays distribution and power transformer deliveries to utilities; customers expect a response the same day; breakdown calls are about 40% of receipts at premium rates
manual_workaround: Use the customer's own engineering workstation and program copy where one exists; paper schematics in the van; phone guidance to customer maintenance staff
dependent_third_parties: Automation makers' license servers (engineering software activation); phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-technician (single point of failure); service van

description: Keeping, updating, and restoring the Customer Machine Library: PLC logic, HMI projects, drive parameters, CNC cutting programs, and winding recipes for about 70 machines at 10 sites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A machine that loses its program cannot run until the right version is reloaded; a wrong or altered version can damage equipment or a transformer coil and endanger operators; Customer A exhibit S1 and S7 and the B and C NDAs govern this data. RPO 24 hours because the library is saved at the end of every visit; changes made by customer staff between visits are not captured
manual_workaround: Ask the customer for its own last copy; rebuild drive parameters from nameplate data and paper records; for USB-loaded machines use the copy on the USB stick if it is clean
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite provider (sync and 30-day version history)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-technician (single point of failure; only person with access)

description: Commissioning and repair of transformer cooling and monitoring control cabinets at utility substations, subcontracted by Customer A; loading monitoring unit firmware and configuration files
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Work is scheduled days ahead around utility outage windows; a missed window is rebooked by the utility; exhibit S4 to S6 (CIP-013-2 R1.2 flow-down) make notice and firmware checks contract duties
manual_workaround: Reschedule with Customer A and the utility; Customer A can send another contractor
dependent_third_parties: Customer A; utility site staff (escort and access)

description: Quotes, invoices, payment follow-up, bank feed, email with customers, tax records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $3,500 invoiced per week; customers pay in 30 to 45 days; the owner has about two months of expenses in savings
manual_workaround: Hand-written job tickets in the van; invoice later; customers pay against the PO
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS provider; bookkeeper (CPA firm); bank

business_process: Scheduled preventive maintenance and vibration monitoring
description: Planned maintenance visits, thermal and power quality surveys, and vibration readings on customer motors (AI-001 trial)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Visits are planned weeks ahead and can move a week without harm; vibration trends tolerate a missed reading
manual_workaround: Reschedule visits; take handheld readings and record them on paper
